name: snapshot
title: Snapshot
description: Return the tab's ARIA accessibility tree (YAML) — purpose-built for LLM consumption. With selector, only the subtree of the first matching element. At most max_chars characters (default 60000) per call. Long results are paged: when truncated is true, call again with offset set to next_offset until next_offset is null. The tree holds what the accessibility tree exposes: collapsed <details>, hidden tab panels and the line breaks of <pre> blocks are not in it; use get_text to read those.

selector.description: Read only the first element matching this selector (ELEMENT_NOT_FOUND when nothing matches).

max_chars.description: Most characters to return in this call (default 60000, at most 200000).

offset.description: Character offset to start from: pass the previous call's next_offset.
